title: Why Agent Traces Pass When Output Fails

steps.status: model generates valid tool call json
agent assumes success and stops early

caption:
Your agent observability trace can be 100% green while your agent completely fails the task.

Here's what actually happens in an agent tool loop:

1. Valid Schema Request — The LLM generates a syntactically perfect tool call matching the JSON schema. The tracing tool logs a green checkmark for LLM generation.
2. Silent API Failure — The tool runner executes the API call. The server responds with HTTP 200 OK, but returns an empty list or missing data payload. Tracing tools log another green status because no exception was thrown.
3. False Completion — The agent receives the empty payload in its context window, hallucinates that the task is finished, and returns a successful response to the user.

When building agentic workflows with OpenAI or Claude, 200 OK status codes mean nothing if payload validation fails.

No magic — just unhandled semantic return values.

Finally, the agent assumes completion and halts early.
